d.ko: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.
d.en: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.
d.zh: 专业地设计基础设施，成为掌控交通的大师。铺设道路、设计路口、调校红绿灯、规划公共交通网络，然后看着城市焕发生机。城市规模会自行扩大，每一座新建筑都会给你修建的道路带来更多出行。
